integrity: All finite cutoff assertions are based on exhaustive connected incidence-mask enumeration, direct integer subset counts, and a full reproducible Python checker. The real-probability claims use coefficientwise polynomial positivity and exact factorization; certificate generated by the included checker. No external or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous independent pollinator survival, a single perfect guarantee, and a static bipartite incidence graph; every plant retained means at least one original pollinator survives. Cutoff is finite at nine total species, and only one ten-species counterexample is established; no classification of all ten-species exceptions, rewiring, correlated losses, heterogeneous rates, or actual plant demographic persistence. Literature novelty remains subject to independent bibliographic review.
title: Ten species are the sharp threshold for survival-dependent protection of an entire pollination guild
